# 📮 .github · ISSUE_TEMPLATE — Structured Issue Forms

> **Navigation:** [`.github`](../../README.md) › **`ISSUE_TEMPLATE`**

![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-IPL--RP--1.0-red?style=flat-square)

YAML-driven **issue forms** that structure every new issue in the repository. The forms collect the fields maintainers need (environment, toolchain version, section/language affected, reproduction steps) directly into the issue body, so verification bugs are reproducible on arrival. The companion `config.yml` sets contact links (discussions / security advisory) and disables blank issues so every report arrives structured.

## 📂 Contents — What Lives Here

| File | Size | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [`bug_report.yml`](bug_report.yml) | 2.0 KB | structured bug report — environment, toolchain, section, reproduction |
| [`config.yml`](config.yml) | 559 B | template chooser config — contact links, blank issues disabled |
| [`feature_request.yml`](feature_request.yml) | 1.8 KB | feature proposal — verification targets, languages, documentation |
